cards.meaning_en: to make an effect, association, or signal weaker
cards.meaning_zh: 减弱；降低
cards.usage_note: 只有效应、关联或信号确实变弱时才能用，比 reduce 更强调“被压小”。不要写成已经消失或被消除。
cards.context_sentence: The association was substantially attenuated after adjustment for age and body mass index.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Taking age and body mass index into account made the observed relationship weaker.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 调整年龄和体重指数后，该关联明显减弱。

cards.meaning_en: remaining reliable when assumptions, samples, or analyses change
cards.meaning_zh: 稳健的；可靠的
cards.usage_note: 换样本、换模型后结果仍站得住才能叫 robust。一次分析好看不够。
cards.context_sentence: The association remained robust in analyses that excluded participants with pre-existing disease.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Removing participants who were already ill did not materially change the result.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 排除既往患病的参与者后，该关联仍然稳健。

cards.meaning_en: to make a mechanism, process, or relationship clearer
cards.meaning_zh: 阐明；解释清楚
cards.usage_note: 机制或关系被真正讲清楚才能用，比 suggest 更强。只是提出可能就别写 elucidate。
cards.context_sentence: Single-cell profiling may elucidate how stromal cells contribute to treatment resistance.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Single-cell data may clarify the part stromal cells play in making treatment less effective.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 单细胞分析可能阐明基质细胞如何促成治疗耐药。

cards.meaning_en: to provide additional evidence that supports a result or account
cards.meaning_zh: 佐证；为……提供支持证据
cards.usage_note: 要有独立证据来撑原来的结果，比 support 更强调另有来源印证。同一批数据再算一遍不算。
cards.context_sentence: The association observed in the discovery cohort was corroborated in an independent sample.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A separate group of participants produced evidence supporting the original result.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 发现队列中观察到的关联在独立样本中得到了佐证。

cards.meaning_en: especially important or noticeable in the current context
cards.meaning_zh: 突出的；值得注意的；重要的
cards.usage_note: 只标当前最扎眼、最该被注意的一点。不等于 statistically significant。
cards.context_sentence: One salient limitation was the absence of repeated dietary measurements during follow-up.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: An important weakness was that the researchers did not measure diet again later.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 一个值得注意的局限是随访期间没有重复测量饮食。

cards.meaning_en: to justify or call for a particular action or conclusion
cards.meaning_zh: 有必要；值得；使……成为合理之举
cards.usage_note: 证据只够支撑“值得谨慎或再查”，撑不起立即改实践。别写成已经证明该做某事。
cards.context_sentence: The modest effect size warrants cautious interpretation rather than an immediate change in practice.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Because the effect was small, the result should be interpreted carefully before practice changes.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 效应量较小，因此应谨慎解释，而不宜立即改变实践。

cards.meaning_en: to mark, describe, or show the boundary of something precisely
cards.meaning_zh: 勾画；界定；清楚标示
cards.usage_note: 边界或范围被清楚标出才能用。普通描述不要写成 delineate。
cards.context_sentence: Dashed white lines delineate the tumor boundary used for image quantification.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The dashed white lines show exactly where the measured tumor region begins and ends.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 白色虚线标出了用于图像定量分析的肿瘤边界。

cards.meaning_en: to explain how apparently conflicting findings can fit together
cards.meaning_zh: 调和；使相互矛盾的结果得到合理解释
cards.usage_note: 两边结果看起来打架、而你能给出合理解释时才用。解释不了就别硬写 reconcile。
cards.context_sentence: Differences in follow-up duration may help reconcile the apparently conflicting estimates.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The estimates may differ because the studies followed participants for different lengths of time.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 随访时长的差异或许有助于解释这些看似相互矛盾的估计值。

cards.meaning_en: to provide the essential support or basis for something
cards.meaning_zh: 构成……的基础；支撑
cards.usage_note: 结论或方法必须被证据或理论撑住才能用，比 support 更硬。证据不够就别用。
cards.context_sentence: Longitudinal sampling underpins our analysis of changes occurring within the same individual.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Repeated samples from each person make it possible to study how that person changes over time.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 纵向采样为分析同一个体内部随时间发生的变化奠定了基础。

cards.meaning_en: to give a property, benefit, or degree of protection
cards.meaning_zh: 赋予；带来
cards.usage_note: 某处理或特征确实带来保护、抗性或优势时才用。相关或伴随出现不够。
cards.context_sentence: The hydrophilic coating conferred resistance to nonspecific protein binding.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The water-attracting coating made the surface less likely to bind proteins nonspecifically.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 亲水涂层赋予了材料抵抗非特异性蛋白结合的能力。

cards.meaning_en: to include several elements within a broader whole
cards.meaning_zh: 包含；涵盖
cards.usage_note: 几个成分明确被包进同一个整体时才用。只是“有关”不要写成 encompass。
cards.context_sentence: The composite endpoint encompassed death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, and urgent revascularization.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The combined outcome counted any death, nonfatal heart attack, or urgent procedure to restore blood flow.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该复合终点包括死亡、非致死性心肌梗死和紧急血运重建。

cards.meaning_en: to make a process or action easier
cards.meaning_zh: 促进；使……更容易
cards.usage_note: 某安排确实让流程更容易才能用，比 cause 弱。不要夸成决定性因素。
cards.context_sentence: Standardized variable names facilitated the merging of data from participating centers.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Using the same variable names made it easier to combine data from all centers.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 标准化变量名称使合并各参与中心的数据更加容易。

cards.meaning_en: to reach a conclusion from evidence rather than direct observation
cards.meaning_zh: 推断；推知
cards.usage_note: 只能从证据推出、不能直接观察到时才用。横断面关联推不出因果。
cards.context_sentence: Causal direction cannot be inferred from the cross-sectional association.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Because the variables were measured at one time, the study cannot show which one caused the other.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 不能根据这一横断面关联推断因果方向。

cards.meaning_en: directly relevant to the subject or decision being considered
cards.meaning_zh: 相关的；切题的
cards.usage_note: 必须直接关系到眼前这个问题，比 related 更严。沾边信息不配这个词。
cards.context_sentence: Additional details pertinent to sample randomization are provided in the Supplementary Methods.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The supplementary section gives more information that is directly relevant to how samples were randomized.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 与样本随机化直接相关的更多细节见补充方法。

cards.meaning_en: to include a factor in an analysis so that its influence is considered
cards.meaning_zh: 将……纳入考虑；校正
cards.usage_note: 模型里真的把该因素算进去了才能用。口头提到但没校正，不要写 account for。
cards.context_sentence: The mixed-effects model accounted for clustering of patients within hospitals.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The model allowed for patients from the same hospital to be more similar to one another.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 混合效应模型考虑了患者在医院内的聚类。

cards.meaning_en: distortion of an exposure-outcome association by another factor associated with the exposure and affecting the outcome
cards.meaning_zh: 混杂；混杂作用
cards.usage_note: 那个因素既连着暴露又连着结局、可能把关联拧弯时才叫 confounding。普通组间差异不是混杂。
cards.context_sentence: Residual confounding cannot be excluded because diet was measured only at baseline.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Dietary differences that were not fully measured may still partly explain the association.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 由于仅在基线测量饮食，仍不能排除残余混杂。

cards.meaning_en: variation in effects or characteristics across studies or subgroups
cards.meaning_zh: 异质性
cards.usage_note: 各研究或亚组之间的差别大到超出抽样误差，才能说 heterogeneity。不要用来形容一次分析里的离散。
cards.context_sentence: Substantial heterogeneity was observed across trials in the pooled analysis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The estimated treatment effects differed considerably among the trials.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 汇总分析显示各试验之间存在较大的异质性。

cards.meaning_en: to replace missing data with plausible values estimated under a stated method
cards.meaning_zh: 插补；估算并填补缺失值
cards.usage_note: 缺失值是按事先说明的方法填的才能用。随便补一个数不要叫 impute。
cards.context_sentence: Missing baseline values were imputed using multiple imputation by chained equations.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The researchers created several plausible replacements for missing baseline measurements using the observed data.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 采用链式方程多重插补法填补了缺失的基线值。

cards.meaning_en: to divide or organize observations into defined subgroups called strata
cards.meaning_zh: 分层；按层划分
cards.usage_note: 按事先定好的层来随机或分析时才用。事后随便分组不是 stratified。
cards.context_sentence: Randomization was stratified by study center and disease stage.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The random assignment was organized separately within each center and disease-stage group.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 随机分组按研究中心和疾病分期进行分层。

cards.meaning_en: a situation in which the effect of one variable depends on another variable
cards.meaning_zh: 交互作用
cards.usage_note: 一个因素的效应随另一个因素改变时才能写。两个因素都显著不等于有 interaction。
cards.context_sentence: There was no evidence of an interaction between treatment assignment and baseline severity.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The data did not show that treatment worked differently in patients with different initial severity.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 没有证据表明治疗分组与基线严重程度之间存在交互作用。

cards.meaning_en: the probability that a study will detect a specified effect if that effect truly exists
cards.meaning_zh: 统计功效；把握度
cards.usage_note: 只在给定效应量、误差和样本量下谈“能检出”的把握。已经做完的不显著结果，不要事后夸 power 足够。
cards.context_sentence: The planned sample size provided 90% power to detect a five-point difference between groups.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If a true five-point difference existed, the planned study had a 90% chance of detecting it under its assumptions.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 按计划的样本量，研究有 90% 的把握度检出组间 5 分的差异。

cards.meaning_en: the process of matching sequence reads to a reference or to one another
cards.meaning_zh: 序列比对
cards.usage_note: 读段已经对到参考或彼此对齐这一步。别把比对质量说成生物学结论。
cards.context_sentence: Low-quality reads were removed before alignment to the reference genome.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Poor-quality reads were discarded before the remaining reads were matched to the reference genome.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在与参考基因组进行序列比对前，先去除了低质量读段。

cards.meaning_en: the number or extent of sequence reads representing a genomic position or region
cards.meaning_zh: 测序覆盖度；覆盖深度
cards.usage_note: 某位点被测到多少遍。覆盖低时变异调用要更谨慎，不要写得很硬。
cards.context_sentence: Variants in regions with sequencing coverage below twenty-fold were excluded from analysis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The analysis omitted variants where fewer than twenty reads represented the genomic region.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 测序覆盖深度低于 20 倍区域内的变异被排除在分析之外。

cards.meaning_en: adjustment of measurements to reduce specified technical differences between samples
cards.meaning_zh: 标准化；归一化
cards.usage_note: 只消减你声明的技术差异，让样本可比较。不能当成已经去掉全部伪影。
cards.context_sentence: Count normalization was performed before gene expression was compared across samples.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Read counts were adjusted for technical scale differences before samples were compared.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在比较不同样本的基因表达之前，对计数数据进行了归一化。

cards.meaning_en: showing or testing a measured difference between biological conditions
cards.meaning_zh: 差异的；用于比较条件间差异的
cards.usage_note: 比较的是条件之间测到的差异。有差异不等于已经证明机制。
cards.context_sentence: We used differential expression analysis to compare treated and untreated cells.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The analysis tested which genes had different expression levels after treatment.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 我们采用差异表达分析比较处理组与未处理组细胞。

cards.meaning_en: overrepresentation of a biological feature in a selected set relative to a background
cards.meaning_zh: 富集；在选定集合中的占比高于背景预期
cards.usage_note: 只能说选定集合里某通路占比高于背景。证明不了通路真的在工作。
cards.context_sentence: Pathway enrichment analysis showed that interferon-response genes were overrepresented among genes upregulated in malignant cells.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Interferon-response genes appeared more often than expected in the list of genes with higher expression in malignant cells.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 通路富集分析显示，恶性细胞上调基因中干扰素反应相关基因的占比高于预期。

cards.meaning_en: a data-derived group of cells or observations with similar measured profiles
cards.meaning_zh: 聚类；由数据划分出的相似对象组
cards.usage_note: 只是表达谱相似的数据分组。不能直接当成生物学细胞类型。
cards.context_sentence: Cells in each transcriptional cluster shared similar expression profiles, but those labels were not assumed to define cell types.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Cells grouped together because their gene expression looked similar, although each group was not automatically called a cell type.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 每个转录聚类中的细胞具有相似的表达谱，但并未假定聚类标签必然代表细胞类型。

cards.meaning_en: an inferred ordering of cells along a biological trajectory rather than clock time
cards.meaning_zh: 伪时间；沿推断生物学轨迹的细胞排序
cards.usage_note: 模型推出来的排序，不是时钟时间。别写成细胞被实际观测到的发育时刻。
cards.context_sentence: Pseudotime ordered cells along an inferred transition from a progenitor-like to a differentiated state.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The method arranged cells by their likely position in a developmental change, not by when they were collected.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 伪时间将细胞沿着从祖细胞样状态向分化状态转变的推断轨迹排序。

cards.meaning_en: systematic technical variation associated with processing groups rather than biology
cards.meaning_zh: 批次效应
cards.usage_note: 批次带来的技术差异。校正时不能把生物学变异一起抹掉。
cards.context_sentence: Batch effects were assessed before libraries prepared on different days were combined.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The team checked whether preparation day created technical differences before merging the libraries.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 合并不同日期制备的文库前，先评估了批次效应。

cards.meaning_en: genes in different species that descended from one ancestral gene through speciation
cards.meaning_zh: 直系同源基因
cards.usage_note: 物种分化留下的对应基因。序列同源不等于功能一定相同。
cards.context_sentence: Human genes were mapped to mouse orthologs before the cross-species comparison.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Each human gene was paired with its evolutionarily corresponding mouse gene before comparison.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 跨物种比较前，将人类基因映射到小鼠直系同源基因。

cards.meaning_en: the inner open space of a hollow organ, vessel, or tube
cards.meaning_zh: 管腔；腔内空间
cards.usage_note: 只指管状结构内部的空腔。不要用来指管壁或器官整体。
cards.context_sentence: Endoscopy revealed a smooth lesion protruding into the gastric lumen.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The camera showed a smooth lesion extending into the open space inside the stomach.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 内镜检查发现一个向胃腔内突出的光滑病变。

cards.meaning_en: an organ region where vessels, nerves, or ducts enter and leave
cards.meaning_zh: 门；器官血管、神经或导管出入的部位
cards.usage_note: 只用于血管、神经或导管进出器官的那一块。不是器官的任意边缘。
cards.context_sentence: At the renal hilum, the vein usually lies anterior to the renal artery.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Where the kidney's vessels enter and leave, the vein is usually in front of the artery.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在肾门处，肾静脉通常位于肾动脉前方。

cards.meaning_en: the delivery of blood through tissue to supply oxygen and nutrients
cards.meaning_zh: 灌注；组织血流供应
cards.usage_note: 组织实际得到的血流。大血管通着不等于远端灌注够。
cards.context_sentence: Mean arterial pressure was maintained to preserve renal perfusion during surgery.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Blood pressure was kept high enough for adequate blood flow through the kidneys during the operation.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 术中维持平均动脉压，以保证肾脏灌注。

cards.meaning_en: the ease with which a structure expands in response to pressure
cards.meaning_zh: 顺应性；受压后扩张的能力
cards.usage_note: 结构受压后好不好扩张；低顺应性就是更硬。不要和“遵医嘱”混用。
cards.context_sentence: Pulmonary fibrosis reduces lung compliance and increases the work needed to breathe.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Scarred lungs are harder to expand, so breathing requires more effort.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 肺纤维化会降低肺顺应性，并增加呼吸做功。

cards.meaning_en: pathologic death of cells or tissue within a living organism
cards.meaning_zh: 坏死
cards.usage_note: 活体内已经发生的病理性细胞或组织死亡。不要和凋亡或尚未坏死的缺血混为一谈。
cards.context_sentence: Histologic examination showed confluent hepatocyte necrosis around the central veins.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Microscopy showed connected areas of dead liver cells around the central veins.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 组织学检查显示中央静脉周围存在融合性肝细胞坏死。

cards.meaning_en: excessive deposition of fibrous connective tissue after chronic injury
cards.meaning_zh: 纤维化
cards.usage_note: 慢性损伤后纤维组织过多沉积。一次炎症反应还不到 fibrosis。
cards.context_sentence: Repeated tissue injury can activate fibroblasts and lead to progressive fibrosis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Ongoing injury can switch on scar-forming cells and cause increasing scar tissue.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 反复组织损伤可激活成纤维细胞，并导致进行性纤维化。

cards.meaning_en: a subjective sensation of difficult or uncomfortable breathing
cards.meaning_zh: 呼吸困难；气促
cards.usage_note: 病人自己感到的呼吸费力，是症状不是诊断。不要写成客观体征或病名。
cards.context_sentence: The patient reported progressive dyspnea on exertion but no chest pain at rest.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The patient had increasing difficulty breathing during activity, although there was no resting chest pain.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 患者诉活动时呼吸困难逐渐加重，但静息时无胸痛。

cards.meaning_en: an abnormal tingling, prickling, or numb sensation without an external stimulus
cards.meaning_zh: 感觉异常；麻刺感
cards.usage_note: 无外界刺激时的麻刺或发麻。客观感觉缺失要另说，不要用这个词代替。
cards.context_sentence: Intermittent paresthesia in both hands became more noticeable at night.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The patient sometimes felt tingling or numbness in both hands, especially at night.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 双手间歇性感觉异常在夜间更为明显。

cards.meaning_en: the feeling of fullness that follows eating
cards.meaning_zh: 饱腹感；饱足感
cards.usage_note: 吃了以后的饱感。early satiety 是吃几口就饱，不是笼统的食欲下降。
cards.context_sentence: She reported early satiety and had begun leaving most of each meal unfinished.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: She felt full after eating only a small amount and could no longer finish meals.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 她诉早饱，并开始常常无法吃完一顿饭。

cards.meaning_en: able to be felt during physical examination
cards.meaning_zh: 可触及的
cards.usage_note: 检查者用手摸到的体征，比 visible 更强调触诊。只看见摸不到就别写 palpable。
cards.context_sentence: A firm, non-tender mass was palpable in the right upper quadrant.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The examiner could feel a firm mass in the right upper abdomen, and it was not painful when pressed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 右上腹可触及一个质硬、无压痛的肿块。

cards.meaning_en: swelling that retains an indentation after pressure is applied
cards.meaning_zh: 凹陷性水肿
cards.usage_note: 按压留坑的水肿，并写清范围。非凹陷性水肿不要套这个词。
cards.context_sentence: Bilateral pitting edema extended to the mid-shin on examination.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Both lower legs were swollen, and pressing the skin left a temporary dent up to the middle of the shin.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 查体见双侧凹陷性水肿延伸至小腿中段。

cards.meaning_en: advanced chronic liver disease with fibrosis and distorted liver architecture
cards.meaning_zh: 肝硬化
cards.usage_note: 肝结构已被纤维化严重改建的晚期病变。单纯脂肪肝或肝炎还不到 cirrhosis。
cards.context_sentence: In advanced cirrhosis, portal hypertension may lead to ascites and variceal bleeding.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Severe long-term liver scarring can raise pressure in the portal circulation, causing abdominal fluid or bleeding veins.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在晚期肝硬化中，门静脉高压可导致腹水和静脉曲张出血。

cards.meaning_en: inflammation of blood vessel walls that can injure affected tissues
cards.meaning_zh: 血管炎
cards.usage_note: 血管壁本身发炎并伤及相应组织。普通皮疹或栓塞不要轻易写成 vasculitis。
cards.context_sentence: Vasculitis was suspected when palpable purpura was accompanied by declining kidney function.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Inflamed blood vessels were considered because the patient had raised purple spots and worsening kidney function.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 当可触性紫癜伴肾功能下降时，医生怀疑血管炎。

cards.meaning_en: the set of plausible conditions considered as explanations for a presentation
cards.meaning_zh: 鉴别诊断
cards.usage_note: 当前仍在考虑的一组可能诊断，会随证据收窄。不是最终诊断。
cards.context_sentence: The differential diagnosis for sudden unilateral weakness included stroke, seizure, and hypoglycemia.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The team considered stroke, seizure, and low blood glucose as possible explanations for the sudden one-sided weakness.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 突发单侧无力的鉴别诊断包括卒中、癫痫发作和低血糖。

cards.meaning_en: considered likely on available evidence but not yet definitively confirmed
cards.meaning_zh: 推定的；初步诊断的
cards.usage_note: 现有证据够先按这个病处理，但还没确诊。别写成已经证实。
cards.context_sentence: A presumptive diagnosis of bacterial meningitis was made while culture results were pending.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The team considered bacterial meningitis likely before the culture had confirmed it.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在培养结果尚未回报时，医生作出了细菌性脑膜炎的推定诊断。

cards.meaning_en: the cause or origin of a disease or clinical condition
cards.meaning_zh: 病因；病因学
cards.usage_note: 只问“什么原因引起”。疾病怎么一步步发展是 pathogenesis，不要混用。
cards.context_sentence: Despite extensive testing, the etiology of the recurrent pancreatitis remained unclear.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Even after many tests, clinicians could not determine what was causing the repeated pancreatitis.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 尽管进行了广泛检查，复发性胰腺炎的病因仍不明确。

cards.meaning_en: a white blood cell count above the reference range
cards.meaning_zh: 白细胞增多
cards.usage_note: 白细胞计数高于参考范围这一化验结果。本身不等于感染。
cards.context_sentence: The complete blood count showed neutrophil-predominant leukocytosis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The blood test showed too many white blood cells, mostly neutrophils.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 血常规显示以中性粒细胞为主的白细胞增多。

cards.meaning_en: to have red blood cells rupture and release their contents into a specimen
cards.meaning_zh: 发生溶血；红细胞破裂
cards.usage_note: 标本里红细胞已经破裂。溶血标本上的钾等结果不要当真，该重抽就重抽。
cards.context_sentence: The potassium result was not reported because the blood specimen was markedly hemolyzed.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The laboratory withheld the potassium value because many red blood cells had broken in the sample.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 由于血液标本明显溶血，实验室未报告血钾结果。

cards.meaning_en: an area that appears whiter or less transparent than surrounding tissue on an image
cards.meaning_zh: 影像学密度增高影；不透亮区
cards.usage_note: 影像上局部更白或不透亮的描述，不是诊断。不要直接写成肺炎或肿块。
cards.context_sentence: The chest radiograph showed a new focal opacity in the right lower lobe.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The chest X-ray showed a new localized white area in the lower part of the right lung.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 胸部 X 线片显示右下叶新出现局灶性密度增高影。

cards.meaning_en: an increase in image signal or attenuation after contrast material is given
cards.meaning_zh: 强化；增强表现
cards.usage_note: 给了对比剂后信号或密度升高。强化不等于恶性。
cards.context_sentence: Contrast-enhanced computed tomography showed peripheral rim enhancement around the collection.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: After contrast was given, the scan showed a brighter ring around the fluid collection.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 增强 CT 显示该积液周围存在周边环形强化。

cards.meaning_en: to adjust a treatment dose gradually according to response or a measured target
cards.meaning_zh: 滴定调整；逐步调节剂量
cards.usage_note: 按明确的反应或靶目标一点点调剂量。没有监测指标就不要写 titrate。
cards.context_sentence: The dose should be titrated gradually according to symptom control and blood pressure.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The dose should be changed in small steps based on whether symptoms improve and blood pressure remains safe.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 应根据症状控制情况和血压逐步调整剂量。

cards.meaning_en: care that prevents or relieves symptoms and maintains comfort and function during illness or treatment
cards.meaning_zh: 支持治疗；对症支持性照护
cards.usage_note: 对症、维持舒适和功能，可以和针对病因的治疗并行。不要写成已经在治原发病。
cards.context_sentence: Supportive care included oral fluids, antiemetics, and monitoring while the viral illness resolved.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The patient received fluids, medicine for nausea, and observation while recovering from the virus.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在病毒性疾病恢复期间，支持治疗包括口服补液、止吐药和监测。

cards.meaning_en: not responding adequately to appropriate treatment
cards.meaning_zh: 难治的；治疗抵抗的
cards.usage_note: 正规剂量、足够疗程后仍不够好才叫 refractory。刚开药无效不要用。
cards.context_sentence: Her neuropathic pain remained refractory to two appropriately dosed first-line medications.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The nerve pain did not improve despite proper doses of two standard first treatments.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 尽管足量使用了两种一线药物，她的神经病理性疼痛仍然难治。

cards.meaning_en: the fraction of an administered dose that reaches systemic circulation unchanged
cards.meaning_zh: 生物利用度
cards.usage_note: 进体循环的那一部分剂量。口服生物利用度低只说明进血少，不等于药无效。
cards.context_sentence: Extensive first-pass metabolism reduces the oral bioavailability of the drug.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The body metabolizes much of the swallowed drug before it reaches the general bloodstream unchanged.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 广泛的首过代谢降低了该药物的口服生物利用度。

cards.meaning_en: to make a treatment inadvisable because its expected risk is unacceptable
cards.meaning_zh: 禁忌；不宜使用
cards.usage_note: 预期风险已经高到不该用，比 use with caution 更硬。能谨慎用就不要写禁忌。
cards.context_sentence: Re-exposure is contraindicated in a patient with prior anaphylaxis to the same medication.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The patient must not receive the medicine again after a previous severe allergic reaction to it.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 既往对同一药物发生过严重全身性过敏反应的患者禁忌再次使用该药。

cards.meaning_en: removal of dead, damaged, or contaminated tissue from a wound
cards.meaning_zh: 清创；清创术
cards.usage_note: 清掉坏死或污染组织这一动作。普通换药清洗还不到都叫 debridement。
cards.context_sentence: Surgical debridement was completed before negative-pressure wound therapy was applied.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The surgeon removed unhealthy tissue before placing the wound under suction-assisted treatment.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 完成外科清创后，应用了负压伤口治疗。

cards.meaning_en: a surgically created connection between two tubular structures
cards.meaning_zh: 吻合；吻合口
cards.usage_note: 两个管状结构被接在一起，或这个接口本身。不要用来指任意缝合。
cards.context_sentence: The bowel anastomosis was inspected for bleeding and leakage before abdominal closure.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Before closing the abdomen, the surgeon checked the joined bowel ends for bleeding or leaks.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 关闭腹腔前，检查了肠吻合口有无出血和渗漏。

cards.meaning_en: to report that a symptom or history is not present
cards.meaning_zh: 否认有；自述没有
cards.usage_note: 病历里只记录患者说没有，不等于客观上排除。别写成已经证实没有。
cards.context_sentence: The patient denies fever, recent travel, or contact with anyone known to be ill.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The patient says there has been no fever, recent travel, or known exposure to a sick person.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 患者否认发热、近期旅行史或与已知患病者接触。

cards.meaning_en: showing no important abnormality in the stated examination or test
cards.meaning_zh: 未见明显异常的
cards.usage_note: 只保证所查的那一项没看到重要异常。不是全身都正常。
cards.context_sentence: The remainder of the neurological examination was unremarkable.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: No important abnormality was found in the rest of the nervous-system examination.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 其余神经系统查体未见明显异常。

cards.meaning_en: no longer available for planned follow-up assessment or contact
cards.meaning_zh: 失访；未能继续随访
cards.usage_note: 计划中的随访没做成，结局会缺、还可能有选择偏倚。一次改期不是失访。
cards.context_sentence: The patient was lost to follow-up after the six-month visit, so later outcomes were unavailable.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: After the six-month visit, the care team could no longer contact the patient and had no later results.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该患者在 6 个月访视后失访，因此无法获得后续结局。

cards.meaning_en: to suggest that a factor is involved in a process or outcome
cards.meaning_zh: 提示……可能参与；牵涉
cards.usage_note: 证据只够指向某个因素可能介入，还没证明它就是原因。比 demonstrate 弱，不要写成已经证实。
cards.context_sentence: These expression changes implicate interferon signaling in the early response to infection.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The expression pattern points to interferon signaling as part of the early response, without proving it is the cause.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 这些表达变化提示干扰素信号可能参与感染的早期应答。

cards.meaning_en: to make a stronger claim or analysis impossible because of a limitation
cards.meaning_zh: 使……无法成立；排除作出更强结论的可能
cards.usage_note: 局限已经大到某类推断做不成时才用。普通缺点用 limit；还没堵死更强结论就别写 preclude。
cards.context_sentence: The absence of pretreatment samples precludes any claim about the direction of change.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Because there were no samples before treatment, the study cannot say whether the values rose or fell.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 缺少治疗前样本，因此无法就变化方向作出任何判断。

cards.meaning_en: to act as an intermediate pathway through which an effect is transmitted
cards.meaning_zh: 介导；作为中间环节传递效应
cards.usage_note: 中间变量被检验后，效应有一部分经它传递才能写 mediate。只是相关或同时出现不够。
cards.context_sentence: The treatment effect on fatigue was partly mediated by the improvement in sleep quality.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Part of the reduction in fatigue appeared to occur because sleep quality improved.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 治疗对疲劳的效应有一部分由睡眠质量改善所介导。

cards.meaning_en: to reduce the severity of a risk, bias, or unwanted effect without removing it
cards.meaning_zh: 减轻；缓解（风险或偏倚）
cards.usage_note: 风险或偏倚被压小但还在。eliminate 是去掉；只说注意到了问题也不够。
cards.context_sentence: Duplicate review of eligibility decisions was used to mitigate misclassification of cases.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Two reviewers checked who qualified for the study so that fewer people would be labeled incorrectly.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 通过对入选决定进行双人复核，以减轻病例错分。

cards.meaning_en: to provide enough evidence to make a claim credible
cards.meaning_zh: 证实；为主张提供足够证据
cards.usage_note: 证据已经把主张撑住，比 suggest 强，比 prove 仍留余地。只有提示或重复同一分析不要写。
cards.context_sentence: Independent replication in two cohorts helped substantiate the proposed risk association.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Seeing the same risk pattern in two separate groups made the proposed association more credible.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在两个队列中的独立重复有助于证实所提出的风险关联。

cards.meaning_en: widely supposed or proposed but not yet demonstrated
cards.meaning_zh: 推定的；假定的；尚未证实的
cards.usage_note: 还只是公认猜测或工作假说。已经实验证实就改用 demonstrated，不要再写 putative。
cards.context_sentence: The receptor is a putative regulator of T-cell exhaustion, although functional data remain limited.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Researchers currently treat the receptor as a possible controller of T-cell exhaustion, but that role is not yet shown.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该受体被当作 T 细胞耗竭的推定调节因子，但功能证据仍然有限。

cards.meaning_en: noticeable but small in size or practical importance
cards.meaning_zh: 不大的；幅度有限的
cards.usage_note: 效应真实存在但幅度小。modest 不等于 statistically significant，也别夸成 substantial。
cards.context_sentence: Weight declined by a modest 1.4 kilograms, with little change in waist circumference.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: People lost only a small amount of weight, and waist size barely changed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 体重仅小幅下降 1.4 千克，腰围几乎没有变化。

cards.meaning_en: to limit what can be inferred or done because of a boundary or shortage
cards.meaning_zh: 限制；约束（可推断或可做的范围）
cards.usage_note: 边界还在，只是活动空间变窄。preclude 是直接做不成；普通提到局限不必上 constrain。
cards.context_sentence: Sparse longitudinal sampling constrained our ability to date the onset of resistance.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Because samples were taken too infrequently, the team could not pin down when resistance first appeared.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 纵向采样稀疏，限制了我们判定耐药出现时间的能力。

cards.meaning_en: to distort an apparent association by mixing in the effect of another factor
cards.meaning_zh: 造成混杂；把关联拧偏
cards.usage_note: 动词指某个因素把暴露–结局关联拧弯。名词 confounding 才是那种偏倚本身，不要混用词性。
cards.context_sentence: Differences in smoking history may confound the association between coffee intake and stroke.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If smokers also drink different amounts of coffee, smoking could make the coffee–stroke link look stronger or weaker than it is.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 吸烟史的差异可能混淆咖啡摄入与卒中之间的关联。

cards.meaning_en: believable given current knowledge, without being shown to be true
cards.meaning_zh: 说得通的；看似合理的
cards.usage_note: 机制或解释在现有知识下站得住，但还没被证明。proven 或 demonstrated 更强，不要提前用。
cards.context_sentence: A shared inflammatory pathway is a plausible explanation for the two clinical observations.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: One inflammation pathway could reasonably account for both findings, although that has not been shown.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 共同的炎症通路是对这两项临床观察的一种看似合理的解释。

cards.meaning_en: offered as a cautious, still-reversible conclusion
cards.meaning_zh: 初步的；暂定的；需谨慎对待的
cards.usage_note: 结论还经不起大力气推广。definitive 完全相反；有独立重复后就不要再写 tentative。
cards.context_sentence: Any recommendation based on this single-center series should remain tentative.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Because the cases all came from one hospital, any practice advice from them should stay provisional.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 基于这一单中心病例系列提出的任何建议都应保持初步。

cards.meaning_en: reasonably assigned to a stated cause after other explanations are considered
cards.meaning_zh: 可归因于；可归咎于
cards.usage_note: 在考虑了其他解释后，仍能把效应派给某个因素。相关或伴随出现不够，也不等于已经证明因果。
cards.context_sentence: About one third of the excess mortality was attributable to uncontrolled hypertension.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: After other factors were taken into account, uncontrolled high blood pressure still explained roughly a third of the extra deaths.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 约三分之一的超额死亡可归因于未控制的高血压。

cards.meaning_en: an explicit warning that limits how far a result should be trusted or applied
cards.meaning_zh: 需注意的限制；解读上的保留条件
cards.usage_note: 用来卡住过度推广。普通 limitation 是弱点清单；caveat 更强调“用这个结果时先记住这一点”。
cards.context_sentence: One important caveat is that adherence was self-reported and could not be verified.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Readers should remember that patients only said they took the treatment, and that was never checked.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 一个重要的保留条件是依从性由自我报告，无法核实。

cards.meaning_en: to abolish a biological effect so that it is no longer observed
cards.meaning_zh: 废除；使效应消失
cards.usage_note: 干预后效应基本没了，比 attenuate 或 reduce 更决断。只是减弱就别写成 abrogate。
cards.context_sentence: Antibody blockade of the receptor abrogated the protective effect of pretreatment.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Blocking the receptor with an antibody removed the protection that pretreatment had provided.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 用抗体阻断该受体后，预处理的保护效应消失。

cards.meaning_en: to emphasize that a finding makes a point especially clear
cards.meaning_zh: 强调；凸显
cards.usage_note: 结果把某一点衬得很醒目时才用。不要用来宣布新发现，也不要和 statistically significant 混为一谈。
cards.context_sentence: The age-related rise in readmission rates underscores the need for earlier follow-up.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The higher readmission rates in older patients make earlier follow-up look especially important.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 再入院率随年龄升高，凸显了更早随访的必要。

cards.meaning_en: to treat a survival observation as incomplete at the last time the outcome was known not to have occurred
cards.meaning_zh: 删失；在末次已知未发生结局的时点截断观察
cards.usage_note: 只用于生存或时间-事件分析里“此后不知结局”。临床失访是 lost to follow-up，不要互相替换。
cards.context_sentence: Participants who remained event-free were censored on the date of last contact.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If no outcome had occurred by the last time the team reached a participant, that person stopped contributing risk time on that date.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 仍未发生结局的参与者在末次联系日期被删失。

cards.meaning_en: the instantaneous rate at which an event occurs among those still at risk
cards.meaning_zh: 风险率；瞬时事件发生率
cards.usage_note: 谈的是仍处在风险集中的人在某一瞬间的事件率。不是普通“危险”，也不等于累计发病率。
cards.context_sentence: The adjusted hazard of hospitalization was 28% lower in the treated group.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Among people who had not yet been hospitalized, the instantaneous hospitalization rate was 28% lower after treatment adjustment.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 校正后，治疗组住院的风险率低 28%。

cards.meaning_en: an analysis that keeps participants in the groups to which they were randomized
cards.meaning_zh: 意向性治疗分析；按随机分组分析
cards.usage_note: 按当初随机到的组来分析，不管后来有没有按方案治疗。as-treated 更窄，不要写成已经证明药效。
cards.context_sentence: The primary endpoint was analyzed under the intention-to-treat principle.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Everyone was analyzed in the group assigned at randomization, even if they later switched or stopped treatment.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 主要终点按意向性治疗原则进行分析。

cards.meaning_en: a planned re-analysis that checks whether a result holds under different assumptions
cards.meaning_zh: 敏感性分析；检验结果是否随假设改变
cards.usage_note: 换假设或换样本后再算一遍，看结论还在不在。不是探索性挖亚组，也不是主分析本身。
cards.context_sentence: A sensitivity analysis that excluded late enrollees left the treatment estimate unchanged.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Repeating the analysis without people who joined late did not change the estimated treatment effect.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 排除晚期入组者后的敏感性分析未改变治疗效应估计。

cards.meaning_en: systematic error from how participants enter, remain in, or are chosen for analysis
cards.meaning_zh: 选择偏倚
cards.usage_note: 谁被选进、留下或拿来分析的方式本身会拧弯结果。普通组间基线不平衡先想 confounding。
cards.context_sentence: Online recruitment may introduce selection bias if healthier adults are more likely to enroll.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If healthier people are more willing to join an online study, the sample may not represent the intended population.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 若更健康的成人更可能报名，线上招募就可能引入选择偏倚。

cards.meaning_en: the inflation of false-positive risk that comes from testing many hypotheses
cards.meaning_zh: 多重性；多次检验带来的假阳性膨胀
cards.usage_note: 检验次数多了，偶然显著也会变多。有预先校正或单一主终点时才谈控制 multiplicity。
cards.context_sentence: The statistical plan specified a hierarchical test to control multiplicity across endpoints.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Endpoints were tested in a pre-set order so that looking at several outcomes would not freely inflate false-positive findings.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 统计计划规定用层级检验来控制各终点之间的多重性。

cards.meaning_en: a single-cell library that actually contains two cells captured together
cards.meaning_zh: 双细胞；同一液滴或孔中捕获了两个细胞
cards.usage_note: 建库时两个细胞被当成一个细胞。不是生物学上的细胞对，过滤后也不要再当真实细胞解释。
cards.context_sentence: Libraries with unusually high gene counts were flagged as likely doublets and removed.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Libraries that detected far more genes than usual were treated as two cells captured together and discarded.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 基因检出数异常高的文库被标为可能的双细胞并被去除。

cards.meaning_en: a random barcode that marks an individual RNA molecule before amplification
cards.meaning_zh: 唯一分子标识符；扩增前标记单个 RNA 分子的随机条码
cards.usage_note: 用来把同一分子的扩增拷贝收成一次计数。没有 UMI 的重复读段不要当成分子数。
cards.context_sentence: Reads that shared the same cell barcode and UMI were collapsed before counting.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Duplicate copies that came from one RNA molecule in one cell were counted only once.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 共享同一细胞条码和 UMI 的读段在计数前被合并。

cards.meaning_en: failure to detect an RNA molecule that is present, producing a false zero count
cards.meaning_zh: 技术性脱落；分子在却测成零的假阴性
cards.usage_note: 单细胞里基因没测到，常常是捕获失败，不是细胞真没表达。更不是研究里的失访。
cards.context_sentence: Zero counts were treated as a mixture of true absence and technical dropout.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A zero could mean the gene was truly off, or that the molecule was present but missed by the assay.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 零计数被当作真实缺失与技术性脱落的混合结果。

cards.meaning_en: the expected proportion of false positives among results called significant
cards.meaning_zh: 错误发现率；在报显著的结果中预期假阳性所占比例
cards.usage_note: 管的是“报出来的这些里能有多少是错的”，不是单个检验的 p 值。阈值以下仍可能有假阳性。
cards.context_sentence: Genes with an FDR below 0.05 were reported as differentially expressed.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A gene was listed as different between conditions only if the expected share of false calls among such genes stayed under 5%.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 错误发现率低于 0.05 的基因被报告为差异表达。

cards.meaning_en: the computational step that decides which sequence differences are present in a sample
cards.meaning_zh: 变异检出；从测序数据判断样本中存在哪些序列差异
cards.usage_note: 只是算法给出的候选变异。低覆盖或重复区的呼叫要更谨慎，不能直接写成致病突变。
cards.context_sentence: Sites with coverage below twenty-fold were excluded from variant calling.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The software was not asked to decide whether a variant was present if fewer than twenty reads covered that site.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 覆盖深度低于 20 倍的位点不纳入变异检出。

cards.meaning_en: a short synthetic sequence ligated to fragments so they can be amplified or sequenced
cards.meaning_zh: 接头；接在片段两端以便扩增或测序的人工序列
cards.usage_note: 文库制备用的测序接头，不是软件接口。残留接头会污染比对，应在分析前去掉。
cards.context_sentence: Trailing adapter sequence was trimmed from reads before alignment.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Artificial tail sequences added during library preparation were cut off before the reads were matched to the genome.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 比对前先从读段中修剪掉末端接头序列。

cards.meaning_en: joint embedding of cells or samples from different datasets after reducing batch-driven separation
cards.meaning_zh: 整合；在减弱批次分离后把不同数据集合到同一表示中
cards.usage_note: 把多个单细胞或组学数据集放到可比较的空间里。不是数学积分，也不能保证生物学差异都被保住。
cards.context_sentence: After integration, cells from the two platforms occupied overlapping regions of the embedding.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Once the two datasets were placed in a shared space, cells no longer sat in separate clouds just because they were generated on different platforms.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 整合后，来自两个平台的细胞在嵌入空间中占据了重叠区域。

cards.meaning_en: the assigned biological labels for genomic features such as genes, transcripts, or variants
cards.meaning_zh: 注释；为基因、转录本或变异等基因组特征赋予的生物学标签
cards.usage_note: 参考数据库给出的位置和功能标签，会随版本更新。不要把注释写成实验测到的功能。
cards.context_sentence: Gene names in the heatmap follow the GENCODE gene annotation used for this analysis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The heatmap uses gene names from the GENCODE catalog chosen for this study, not from a different annotation set.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 热图中的基因名遵循本次分析所用的 GENCODE 基因注释。

cards.meaning_en: a set of variants inherited together on one chromosome copy
cards.meaning_zh: 单倍型；同一条染色体拷贝上连锁遗传的一组变异
cards.usage_note: 一条染色体上一起传下去的等位组合。基因型是两个单倍型的无序对，不要互相替换。
cards.context_sentence: The risk haplotype carried both the promoter variant and the coding substitution.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: On the same chromosome copy, the promoter change and the coding change were inherited together in the higher-risk version.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该风险单倍型同时携带启动子变异和编码区替换。

cards.meaning_en: abnormal narrowing of a lumen such as a vessel, valve, or canal
cards.meaning_zh: 狭窄；管腔异常变窄
cards.usage_note: 管腔比正常窄，要写清部位和程度。不是管壁增厚本身，也不等于已经缺血。
cards.context_sentence: Computed tomography showed high-grade stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The scan found severe narrowing near the start of a major artery on the front of the left heart.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: CT 显示左前降支近段重度狭窄。

cards.meaning_en: the functional tissue of an organ, as distinct from its supporting framework
cards.meaning_zh: 实质；器官发挥功能的组织，有别于支架结构
cards.usage_note: 指肝、肺、肾等真正做事的组织。包膜、血管或间质支架不要写成 parenchyma。
cards.context_sentence: Most of the kidney's filtering work occurs in the renal parenchyma rather than in the collecting system.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Urine is filtered in the working tissue of the kidney, not in the drainage passages that collect it.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 肾脏的大部分滤过工作发生在肾实质，而不是集合系统。

cards.meaning_en: active maintenance of a stable internal environment within a narrow range
cards.meaning_zh: 稳态；把内环境主动维持在狭窄范围内
cards.usage_note: 是主动调节后的稳定，不是“什么都没变”。一次实验室值正常也不等于稳态已恢复。
cards.context_sentence: Aldosterone helps maintain sodium homeostasis when dietary intake falls.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: When people eat less salt, aldosterone helps keep body sodium from drifting too low.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 饮食钠摄入下降时，醛固酮有助于维持钠稳态。

cards.meaning_en: the ventricular wall stretch at the end of filling, reflecting venous return
cards.meaning_zh: 前负荷；心室充盈末期的壁伸展，反映回心血量
cards.usage_note: 泵血前心室被充了多少。afterload 是泵血时要克服的阻力，二者不要对调。
cards.context_sentence: Diuretics were reduced to preserve preload in the patient with right ventricular infarction.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Water pills were cut back so that enough blood still filled the damaged right ventricle before each beat.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 对右心室梗死患者减少利尿剂，以保留前负荷。

cards.meaning_en: inadequate blood flow that leaves tissue short of oxygen and nutrients
cards.meaning_zh: 缺血；血流不足以供应组织氧和营养
cards.usage_note: 组织还没死，只是供血不够。梗死是缺血持续后的坏死，不要提前写成 infarction。
cards.context_sentence: Transient mesenteric ischemia can cause severe pain before bowel infarction develops.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A shortfall of blood flow to the gut can hurt badly even before the bowel tissue has died.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 短暂的肠系膜缺血可在肠梗死出现前就引起剧痛。

cards.meaning_en: disordered cell growth and architecture that is not yet invasive cancer
cards.meaning_zh: 发育异常；细胞生长和结构紊乱但尚未浸润
cards.usage_note: 形态已经乱，但还不是浸润癌。炎症修复或单纯增生不要随口写成 dysplasia。
cards.context_sentence: Biopsy of the cervical lesion showed high-grade dysplasia without stromal invasion.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The cervical sample showed severely disordered cells, but they had not grown into the supporting tissue.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 宫颈病变活检显示高级别上皮内瘤变/发育异常，未见间质浸润。

cards.meaning_en: a brief, self-limited loss of consciousness from transient cerebral hypoperfusion
cards.meaning_zh: 晕厥；因一过性脑灌注不足导致的短暂意识丧失
cards.usage_note: 真的短暂失去意识后又自己恢复。头昏或要摔倒但没失去意识不要写成 syncope。
cards.context_sentence: He had a witnessed syncope while standing in line and regained awareness within a minute.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: He briefly passed out while standing, and someone saw him recover within a minute.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 他在排队站立时发生目击下晕厥，约一分钟内意识恢复。

cards.meaning_en: breathlessness that appears or worsens when the patient lies flat
cards.meaning_zh: 端坐呼吸；平卧时出现或加重的气促
cards.usage_note: 平躺就喘、坐起好转。夜间阵发性呼吸困难是睡着后再憋醒，不要和这一条混成一个词。
cards.context_sentence: She developed orthopnea and began sleeping on two pillows to stay upright.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: She became short of breath when lying flat and started using two pillows to keep her chest raised.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 她出现端坐呼吸，并开始垫两个枕头半卧睡觉。

cards.meaning_en: severe, illness-related wasting of muscle and weight that is not explained by fasting alone
cards.meaning_zh: 恶病质；疾病相关的显著肌肉和体重消耗
cards.usage_note: 慢性病引起的消耗，不是单纯几天没吃饱。普通体重下降先写 weight loss。
cards.context_sentence: Progressive cachexia developed over three months despite continued oral intake.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: He kept losing muscle and weight for three months even though he was still eating.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 尽管仍能经口进食，三个月来仍出现进行性恶病质。

cards.meaning_en: abnormal accumulation of fluid in the peritoneal cavity
cards.meaning_zh: 腹水；腹腔内异常积液
cards.usage_note: 查体或影像确认腹腔里有游离液体。腹胀本身不够，也不等于已经是肝硬化。
cards.context_sentence: Shifting dullness and a fluid wave were consistent with moderate ascites.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The abdominal exam suggested a moderate amount of free fluid in the belly.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 移动性浊音和液波震颤符合中等量腹水。

cards.meaning_en: enlarged lymph nodes detected on examination or imaging
cards.meaning_zh: 淋巴结肿大
cards.usage_note: 淋巴结比正常大，要写部位。摸到肿块但不确定是淋巴结时，先别写成 lymphadenopathy。
cards.context_sentence: Tender cervical lymphadenopathy was present on the same side as the pharyngitis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Enlarged, tender neck nodes were found on the same side as the sore throat.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 咽炎同侧可触及压痛性颈部淋巴结肿大。

cards.meaning_en: life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated response to infection
cards.meaning_zh: 脓毒症；感染引发的失控宿主反应并导致器官功能障碍
cards.usage_note: 有感染加上器官功能变差。菌血症或单纯发热还不到 sepsis，也不要用它代替具体感染灶。
cards.context_sentence: Sepsis should be suspected when infection is accompanied by an acute rise in the Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: If a patient has an infection and organ function suddenly worsens on a standard score, treat the picture as sepsis until proven otherwise.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 当感染伴随序贯器官衰竭评估评分急性升高时，应怀疑脓毒症。

cards.meaning_en: sudden blockage of a vessel by material carried from elsewhere in the circulation
cards.meaning_zh: 栓塞；循环中的栓子突然堵住血管
cards.usage_note: 栓子从别处漂来堵住血管。血栓形成在原位，血栓形成和栓塞不要混成一个词。
cards.context_sentence: Acute limb ischemia was attributed to embolism from atrial fibrillation rather than local thrombosis.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The sudden loss of blood flow in the limb was thought to come from a clot that traveled out of the heart, not one that formed in the leg artery.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 急性肢体缺血被归因于心房颤动引起的栓塞，而不是局部血栓形成。

cards.meaning_en: the sequence of biological events by which a disease develops
cards.meaning_zh: 发病机制；疾病逐步形成的生物学过程
cards.usage_note: 问疾病怎么一步步发展。etiology 问的是什么原因引起，二者不要对调。
cards.context_sentence: The pathogenesis of diabetic nephropathy begins with glomerular hyperfiltration and progressive matrix expansion.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Diabetic kidney damage develops through a sequence that starts with overfiltering glomeruli and later scar-like matrix buildup.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 糖尿病肾病的发病机制始于肾小球高滤过和基质进行性扩张。

cards.meaning_en: arising without an identified cause after reasonable evaluation
cards.meaning_zh: 特发的；在合理检查后仍找不到病因的
cards.usage_note: 查过了仍不知道原因才叫 idiopathic。还没查完用 unknown；治疗引起的是 iatrogenic。
cards.context_sentence: After negative imaging and laboratory evaluation, the pancreatitis was classified as idiopathic.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Scans and blood tests did not find a cause, so the pancreatitis was labeled as having no identified origin.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 影像和实验室评估均为阴性后，胰腺炎被归为特发性。

cards.meaning_en: caused by a diagnostic or therapeutic intervention rather than by the original disease
cards.meaning_zh: 医源性的；由诊疗操作引起，而非原发病本身
cards.usage_note: 问题来自检查或治疗。特发是找不到原因；并发症若能明确追到操作，用 iatrogenic 更准。
cards.context_sentence: The pneumothorax was iatrogenic after central venous catheter placement.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The collapsed lung appeared after a central line was placed, not from the illness that brought the patient in.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 气胸发生在中心静脉置管之后，属医源性。

cards.meaning_en: a platelet count below the reference range
cards.meaning_zh: 血小板减少
cards.usage_note: 化验上血小板低于参考范围。它本身不是出血诊断，假性减少要先排除标本凝块。
cards.context_sentence: The complete blood count showed isolated thrombocytopenia with a platelet count of 42 × 10^9/L.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The blood count found a low platelet number and no other cell-line abnormality.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 血常规显示孤立性血小板减少，血小板计数为 42 × 10^9/L。

cards.meaning_en: informal laboratory shorthand for elevated aminotransferase levels
cards.meaning_zh: 转氨酶升高（非正式化验说法）
cards.usage_note: 病历里对 ALT/AST 升高的简称，不是独立疾病。写论文或出院诊断时更宜写 elevated transaminases。
cards.context_sentence: Mild transaminitis was noted, with alanine aminotransferase twice the upper reference limit.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The liver enzyme alanine aminotransferase was about twice the usual upper limit, and the note used informal shorthand for that rise.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 记录到轻度转氨酶升高，丙氨酸氨基转移酶为参考上限的两倍。

cards.meaning_en: abnormal fluid collected in a body cavity, described on imaging or examination
cards.meaning_zh: 积液；体腔内异常聚集的液体
cards.usage_note: 腔隙里多了液体这一影像或体征，不是炎症诊断。腹水是腹膜腔积液的临床说法，胸腔仍写 effusion。
cards.context_sentence: The chest radiograph demonstrated a moderate right pleural effusion without pneumothorax.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The chest X-ray showed a moderate fluid collection around the right lung and no air leak.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 胸部 X 线片显示右侧中等量胸腔积液，无气胸。

cards.meaning_en: a poorly defined area of increased lung density that may represent filling of airspace or interstitium
cards.meaning_zh: 浸润影；肺野内边界不清的密度增高区
cards.usage_note: 影像描述，不是肺炎诊断。比 opacity 更暗示物质进入气腔或间质，但仍不能直接写成感染。
cards.context_sentence: A new left-lower-lobe infiltrate was seen compared with the radiograph from two days earlier.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The new film showed a fuzzy dense patch in the lower left lung that had not been there two days before.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 与两天前的胸片相比，可见左下叶新出现浸润影。

cards.meaning_en: started on likely pathogens or usual practice before confirmatory results are back
cards.meaning_zh: 经验性的；在确诊结果回报前按常见情况先治
cards.usage_note: 培养或药敏还没回来就先覆盖最可能的情况。针对性治疗是 targeted，二者不要对调。
cards.context_sentence: Empiric vancomycin was started after blood cultures were drawn but before organism identification.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Vancomycin was given based on the usual serious bacteria in this setting, after cultures were taken and before the organism was named.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在抽血培养之后、病原体鉴定之前，开始经验性使用万古霉素。

cards.meaning_en: treatment given to prevent a disease or complication rather than to treat it after it appears
cards.meaning_zh: 预防；预防性用药或措施
cards.usage_note: 事情还没发生时用来防止它发生。已经在治活动性疾病就不是 prophylaxis。
cards.context_sentence: Low-molecular-weight heparin was given for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis after hip replacement.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A blood thinner was used to prevent clots after hip replacement, not to treat a clot that had already formed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 髋关节置换后给予低分子肝素以预防静脉血栓栓塞。

cards.meaning_en: given after definitive local treatment to lower the risk of recurrence
cards.meaning_zh: 辅助的；根治性局部治疗后为降低复发风险而加用的
cards.usage_note: 手术或放疗之后再补上的全身治疗。新辅助是做之前，转移灶的解救治疗也不是 adjuvant。
cards.context_sentence: Adjuvant chemotherapy was offered after complete resection of the node-positive tumor.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Chemotherapy was proposed after the tumor and involved nodes had already been fully removed, to reduce the chance of return.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在完整切除淋巴结阳性肿瘤后，建议给予辅助化疗。

cards.meaning_en: the time required for the amount of drug in the body to fall by half
cards.meaning_zh: 半衰期；体内药量降至一半所需时间
cards.usage_note: 浓度大约降一半的时间，用来安排给药间隔。作用持续时间可以更长或更短，不要划等号。
cards.context_sentence: Because the drug has a 36-hour half-life, once-daily dosing is usually sufficient.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The amount of drug in the body falls by about half in a day and a half, so one dose a day is usually enough.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该药半衰期为 36 小时，因此通常每日一次给药即可。

cards.meaning_en: a ligand that binds a receptor and activates it
cards.meaning_zh: 激动剂；与受体结合并激活它的配体
cards.usage_note: 结合并且打开这条通路。拮抗剂是占着位置不激活，不要写成相反的药。
cards.context_sentence: A long-acting beta-2 receptor agonist relaxes airway smooth muscle.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The inhaled medicine turns on beta-2 receptors and thereby loosens the muscles around the airways.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 长效 β2 受体激动剂使气道平滑肌舒张。

cards.meaning_en: surgical removal of part or all of an organ or lesion
cards.meaning_zh: 切除；手术去除器官或病变的一部或全部
cards.usage_note: 组织被切下来。单纯切开探查或造口还不到 resection；活检只取一小块。
cards.context_sentence: Segmental small-bowel resection was performed, and bowel continuity was restored.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A portion of small intestine was removed, and the remaining ends were joined again.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 施行了小肠节段切除，并恢复了肠道连续性。

cards.meaning_en: tying or clipping a vessel or duct to occlude it
cards.meaning_zh: 结扎；把血管或导管扎闭
cards.usage_note: 用线或夹子把管道扎住。切断是 transection，缝合对合是 anastomosis，不要混用。
cards.context_sentence: The cystic artery was controlled with ligation before the gallbladder was taken down.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The artery to the gallbladder was tied off before the organ was separated from the liver.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 在游离胆囊之前，先结扎控制胆囊动脉。

cards.meaning_en: to come to medical attention already having the stated symptoms or findings
cards.meaning_zh: 以……为主诉或表现为……就诊
cards.usage_note: 记录患者来时带着哪些表现。不是“赠送”或普通 appear；确诊后的病程进展也不要用它开头。
cards.context_sentence: She presented with three days of fever and a productive cough.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: When she sought care, she had already had fever and a cough that brought up sputum for three days.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 她因发热三天伴咳痰就诊。

cards.meaning_en: having blood pressure and perfusion adequate to support organ function at the moment of assessment
cards.meaning_zh: 血流动力学稳定；当时血压和灌注尚能维持器官功能
cards.usage_note: 只保证循环数字和灌注当时够用。一般情况尚可或神志清楚都代替不了这一条。
cards.context_sentence: The patient remained hemodynamically stable after two liters of crystalloid.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: After two liters of intravenous fluid, blood pressure and organ perfusion were still adequate.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 输入两升晶体液后，患者仍保持血流动力学稳定。

cards.meaning_en: currently in the state that follows a named procedure or event
cards.meaning_zh: ……术后/事后状态；处于某操作或事件之后
cards.usage_note: 病历缩写，说明当前处在某手术或事件之后。不要写成正在做手术，也不要用它代替完整手术史叙述。
cards.context_sentence: The patient is status post laparoscopic cholecystectomy on hospital day two.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: By the second hospital day, the gallbladder had already been removed through small incisions.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 患者为住院第 2 天腹腔镜胆囊切除术后状态。
